messages.subject: how to group individuals into separate clusters with out having prior group information
parts:
Hi to all
Good Afternoon

I have SNP genotyping on 93 individuals with 395 SNP markers and please see attached dummy data and code I used for analysis. Here I do not have any prior information on grouping variable and I just have genotypes and their SNP marker data. I would like to group them into separate groups using DAPC function. I tried with attached code and I am getting empty cluster numbers with out their members in it. I do not know where it went wrong in this analysis. Can any one help me to solve out this problem.
Thanking you very much

With kind Regards

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] how to group individuals into separate clusters with out having prior group information
parts:
Hello,

I have not run the code, but you may be over-fitting your model (i.e. choosing too many principal components in the DAPC step) and all the points are very tightly concentrated within these clusters so that the labels overlap the points. I would recommend reading the DAPC manual in adegenet:

https://github.com/thibautjombart/adegenet/wiki/Tutorials

Best,
Zhian
